question: The average speed of a train running at a speed of 30 km/h during the first 100 km, at the speed of 40 km/h during the second 100 km and at the speed of 50 km/h during the last 100 km is nearly _____.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For three equal distances (100 km each), the Average Speed is the harmonic mean of the speeds.

Average Speed = 3 × s₁ × s₂ × s₃ / (s₁s₂ + s₂s₃ + s₃s₁)

⇒ Average Speed = 3 × 30 × 40 × 50 / (30 × 40 + 40 × 50 + 50 × 30)

⇒ Average Speed = 180000 / (1200 + 2000 + 1500) = 180000 / 4700

⇒ Average Speed = 1800 / 47 ≈ 38.297 km/h

**∴ The correct option is B.**
